title.zh: 卷二十五 本紀第二十五: 道宗五
title.raw: 卷二十五 本紀第二十五: 道宗五 Volume 25 Annals 25: Daozong 5

sentences.zh: 道宗五

translations.literal: Daozong, Part Five
translations.idiomatic: Daozong, Part Five

sentences.zh: 三年春正月乙卯，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: In the third year, spring, first month, on yimao day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on yimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，出錢粟振南京貧民，仍復其租賦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day money and grain were issued to relieve poor people in Nanjing, and their rent and tax were also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day money and grain were issued to relieve poor people in Nanjing, and their rent and tax were also remitted.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大雪。

translations.literal: On jimao day heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day heavy snow fell.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，發粟振中京饑。

translations.literal: Second month, on bingxu day, grain was issued to relieve famine in the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the second month grain was issued to relieve famine in the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以民多流散，除安泊逃戶征償法。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, because many people had drifted away, the law on collecting compensation from escaped households at Anbo was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, because many people had drifted away, the law on collecting compensation from escaped households at Anbo was abolished.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Third month, on yimao day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the third month Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，免錦州貧民租一年。

translations.literal: On jiwei day rent for poor people in Jin Prefecture was remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day rent for poor people in Jin Prefecture was remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，免上京貧民租如錦州。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day rent for poor people at the Supreme Capital was remitted as at Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day rent for poor people at the Supreme Capital was remitted as at Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，女直貢良馬。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Jurchen presented fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jurchen presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，賜中京貧民帛，及免諸路貢輸之半。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wuzi day, silk was bestowed on poor people in the Central Capital, and half of tribute deliveries in all routes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the fourth summer month silk was bestowed on poor people in the Central Capital, and half of tribute deliveries in all routes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙申，賜隈烏古部貧民帛。

translations.literal: On bingshen day silk was bestowed on poor people of the Kui Wugu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day silk was bestowed on poor people of the Kui Wugu tribe.

sentences.zh: 庚子，如涼陘。

translations.literal: On gengzi day went to Liang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the court went to Liang Pass.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，南府宰相王績薨。

translations.literal: On jiachen day Southern Court chancellor Wang Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Southern Court chancellor Wang Ji died.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔出戶部司粟，振諸路流民及義州之饑。

translations.literal: On yisi day, edict ordered Household Department grain issued to relieve refugees in all routes and famine in Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered Household Department grain issued to relieve refugees in all routes and famine in Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，海雲寺進濟民錢千萬。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on gengshen day Haiyun Temple presented ten million cash to aid the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the fifth month Haiyun Temple presented ten million cash to aid the people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，獵黑嶺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day, hunted at Heiling.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Heiling.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，出雜帛賜興聖宮貧民。

translations.literal: On dingsi day miscellaneous silks were issued to relieve poor people of Xing Sheng Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day miscellaneous silks were issued to relieve poor people of Xing Sheng Palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大雨，罷獵。

translations.literal: On gengwu day heavy rain fell and hunting was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day heavy rain fell and hunting was stopped.

sentences.zh: 丁，秦越國王阿璉薨。

translations.literal: On a ding day Prince of Qin and Yue Alian died.
translations.idiomatic: On a ding day Prince of Qin and Yue Alian died.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，駐蹕匣魯金。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yihai day, halted at Xialujin.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the ninth month the court halted at Xialujin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，以參知政事王經為三司使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengchen day Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Jing was made Three Departments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the tenth winter month Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Jing was made Three Departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，罷節度使已下官進珍玩。

translations.literal: On renchen day forbidden military commissioners and officials below from presenting curios.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day military commissioners and officials below were forbidden from presenting curios.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，追封秦越國王阿璉為秦魏國王。

translations.literal: On guimao day posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qin and Yue Alian as Prince of Qin and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Prince of Qin and Yue Alian was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Qin and Wei.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，以惕隱耶律坦同知南京留守事，遼興軍節度使耶律王九為南府宰相。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiayin day tiyin Yelü Tan associate regent of Nanjing; Liaoxing Army military commissioner Yelü Wangjiu Southern Court chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the eleventh month tiyin Yelü Tan was made associate regent of Nanjing; Liaoxing Army military commissioner Yelü Wangjiu was made Southern Court chancellor.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯朔，以樞密直學士呂嗣立參知政事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jimao new moon, Privy Council academician Lü Sili Associate Administrator of Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the twelfth month Privy Council academician Lü Sili was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚戌，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, first month, on gengxu day, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on gengxu day of the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Venus was seen in daytime.

sentences.zh: 甲子，五國部長來貢。

translations.literal: On jiazi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day chieftains of the Five States came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，免上京逋逃及貧戶稅賦。

translations.literal: On gengwu day rent and tax for fugitives and poor households at the Supreme Capital were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day rent and tax for fugitives and poor households at the Supreme Capital were remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以上京、南京饑，許良人自鬻。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, because the Supreme and Nanjing capitals had famine, commoners were permitted to sell themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because the Supreme and Nanjing capitals had famine, commoners were permitted to sell themselves.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，曲赦西京役徒。

translations.literal: On dingchou day partial amnesty for convict laborers at the Western Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day a partial amnesty was granted for convict laborers at the Western Capital.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: Second month, on jichou day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day of the second month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 甲午，曲赦春州役徒，終身者皆五歲免。

translations.literal: On jiawu day partial amnesty for convict laborers at Chun Prefecture; those sentenced for life all remitted after five years.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day a partial amnesty was granted for convict laborers at Chun Prefecture; those sentenced for life were all remitted after five years.

sentences.zh: 己亥，如春州。

translations.literal: On jihai day went to Chun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the court went to Chun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 赦泰州役徒。

translations.literal: Amnesty for convict laborers at Tai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Amnesty was granted for convict laborers at Tai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月己丑，免高麗歲貢。

translations.literal: Third month, on jichou day Goryeo's yearly tribute was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day of the third month Goryeo's yearly tribute was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，振上京及平、錦、來三州饑。

translations.literal: On jisi day relieved famine at the Supreme Capital and Ping, Jin, and Lai prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day famine at the Supreme Capital and Ping, Jin, and Lai prefectures was relieved.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，振蘇、吉、復、淥、鐵五州貧民，並免其租稅。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jimao day, relieved poor people in Su, Ji, Fu, Lu, and Tie prefectures and remitted their rent and tax.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day of the fourth summer month poor people in Su, Ji, Fu, Lu, and Tie prefectures were relieved and their rent and tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲申，振慶州貧民。

translations.literal: On jiashen day relieved poor people in Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day poor people in Qing Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，減諸路常貢服御物。

translations.literal: On yiyou day regular tribute of imperial goods in all routes was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day regular tribute of imperial goods in all routes was reduced.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，立入粟補官法。

translations.literal: On dingyou day established the law on entering grain to obtain office.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the law on entering grain to obtain office was established.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，西幸。

translations.literal: On guimao day traveled west.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court traveled west.

sentences.zh: 召樞密直學士耶律儼講《尚書·洪範》。

translations.literal: Summoned Privy Council academician Yelü Yan to lecture on the 《Hongfan》 chapter of the 《Book of Documents》.
translations.idiomatic: Privy Council academician Yelü Yan was summoned to lecture on the 《Hongfan》 chapter of the 《Book of Documents》.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，命燕國王延禧寫《尚書·五子之歌》。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinhai day, ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to copy the 《Five Sons' Songs》 from the 《Book of Documents》.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the fifth month Prince of Yan Yanxi was ordered to copy the 《Five Sons' Songs》 from the 《Book of Documents》.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，振祖州貧民。

translations.literal: On yimao day relieved poor people in Zu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day poor people in Zu Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔免役徒，終身者五歲免之。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, edict remitted convict labor; those sentenced for life were remitted after five years.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict remitted convict labor; those sentenced for life were remitted after five years.

sentences.zh: 己未，振春州貧民。

translations.literal: On jiwei day relieved poor people in Chun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day poor people in Chun Prefecture were relieved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禁挾私引水犯田。

translations.literal: On bingyin day forbidden diverting water privately to encroach on fields.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day diverting water privately to encroach on fields was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，駐蹕散水原。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengchen day, halted at Sanshui Plain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the sixth month the court halted at Sanshui Plain.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命燕國王延禧知中丞司事，以同知南院樞密使事耶律聶裏知右夷離畢，知右夷離畢事耶律那也同知南院樞密使事。

translations.literal: On dinghai day ordered Prince of Yan Yanxi to administer Central Secretariat affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Nieli administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Yelü Naye, who administered Right yilibi affairs, associate Southern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince of Yan Yanxi was ordered to administer Central Secretariat affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Nieli was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Yelü Naye, who administered Right yilibi affairs, was made associate Southern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，北院樞密使耶律頗德致仕。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Pode retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Northern Court privy commissioner Yelü Pode retired.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，曲赦奉聖州役徒。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on wushen day partial amnesty for convict laborers at Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the seventh month a partial amnesty was granted for convict laborers at Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遣使冊李乾順為夏國王。

translations.literal: On bingchen day dispatched envoys to invest Li Qianshun as king of Xia State.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day envoys were dispatched to invest Li Qianshun as king of Xia State.

sentences.zh: 庚申，如秋山。

translations.literal: On gengshen day went to autumn mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the court went to autumn mountains.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禁錢出境。

translations.literal: On jisi day forbidden cash to leave the border.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day cash was forbidden to leave the border.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，有司奏宛平、永清蝗為飛鳥所食。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengchen day the relevant offices memorialized that locusts in Wanping and Yongqing were eaten by birds.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the eighth month the relevant offices memorialized that locusts in Wanping and Yongqing were eaten by birds.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，謁慶陵。

translations.literal: On gengyin day paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court paid respects at Qing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，獵遼水之濱。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingchou day, hunted on the banks of the Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day of the tenth winter month the court hunted on the banks of the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 己卯，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On jimao day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸未，免百姓所貸官粟。

translations.literal: On guimao day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day government grain lent to commoners was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己丑，知北院樞密使事耶律阿思封漆水郡王。

translations.literal: On jichou day Yelü Asi, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Yelü Asi, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was enfeoffed Prince of Qishui Commandery.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以乙室大王耶律敵烈知西北路招討使事，權知西北路招討使事蕭朽哥知乙室大王事。

translations.literal: On guisi day Yishi great king Yelü Dilie was made to administer Northwest Route pacification affairs; acting Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Xiuge administrator of Yishi great king affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Yishi great king Yelü Dilie was made to administer Northwest Route pacification affairs; acting Northwest Route pacification commissioner Xiao Xiuge was made administrator of Yishi great king affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔諸部長官親鞫獄訟。

translations.literal: On renyin day, edict ordered tribal chiefs in all tribes to judge lawsuits in person.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day an edict ordered tribal chiefs in all tribes to judge lawsuits in person.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，興中府民張化法以父兄犯盜當之，請代，皆免。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengshen day Xingzhong Prefecture commoner Zhang Huafa, because his father and elder brother had committed robbery for which he should stand punishment, begged to substitute; all were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day of the eleventh month Xingzhong Prefecture commoner Zhang Huafa, because his father and elder brother had committed robbery for which he should stand punishment, begged to substitute; all were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，南府宰相耶律王九致仕。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin day Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wangjiu retired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day of the twelfth month Southern Court chancellor Yelü Wangjiu retired.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以孟父敞穩耶律慎思為中京留守。

translations.literal: On guimao day Mengfu detail-stable Yelü Shensi was made regent of the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Mengfu detail-stable Yelü Shensi was made regent of the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月癸卯朔，預行正旦禮。

translations.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on guimao new moon, New Year's rites were performed in advance.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon of the intercalary twelfth month New Year's rites were performed in advance.

sentences.zh: 丙午，如混同江。

translations.literal: On bingwu day went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月癸未，如魚兒濼。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on guimao day, went to Yuer Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on guimao day of the first spring month the court went to Yuer Marsh.

sentences.zh: 甲午，高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Goryeo dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，詔析津、大定二府精選舉人以聞，仍詔諭學者，當窮經明道。

translations.literal: Third month, on guiyou day, edict ordered Jizhou and Dading prefectures to select examination candidates carefully and report them; also edict instructed scholars to exhaust the classics and clarify the Way.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the third month an edict ordered Jizhou and Dading prefectures to select examination candidates carefully and report them; scholars were also instructed to exhaust the classics and clarify the Way.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，以知奚六部大王事涅葛為本部大王。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiachen day Niege, who administered Xi Six Tribes great king affairs, was made great king of that tribe.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the fourth summer month Niege, who administered Xi Six Tribes great king affairs, was made great king of that tribe.

sentences.zh: 壬子，獵北山。

translations.literal: On renzi day hunted at North Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the court hunted at North Mountain.

sentences.zh: 甲子，霖雨，罷獵。

translations.literal: On jiazi day continuous rain fell and hunting was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day continuous rain fell and hunting was stopped.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，駐蹕赤勒嶺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on dinghai day, halted at Chile Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the fifth month the court halted at Chile Ridge.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以阻卜磨古斯為諸部長。

translations.literal: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Zubu Mogusi was made chief of all tribes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，回鶻遣使貢良馬。

translations.literal: On guisi day Uighur dispatched envoys presenting fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Uighur sent envoys presenting fine horses.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以同知南府樞密使事耶律那也知右夷離畢事，左祗候郎君班詳穩耶律涅裏知北院大王事。

translations.literal: On jihai day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Naye administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Left attendant langjun class detail-stable Yelü Nieli administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Naye was made administrator of Right yilibi affairs; Left attendant langjun class detail-stable Yelü Nieli was made administrator of Northern Court great king affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，夏國遣使來謝封冊。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin day Xia State dispatched envoys to thank for the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the sixth month Xia State sent envoys to thank for the investiture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以參知政事王言敷為樞密副使，前樞密副使賈士勛參知政事，兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On renxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Yanfu associate privy commissioner; former associate privy commissioner Jia Shixun Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Wang Yanfu was made associate privy commissioner; former associate privy commissioner Jia Shixun was made Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，獵沙嶺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengwu day, hunted at Shaling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Shaling.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，遣使遺宋鹿脯。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinmao day dispatched envoys to present dried venison to Song.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the ninth month envoys were dispatched to present dried venison to Song.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: On renchen day halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，以新定法令太煩，復行舊法。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yisi day, because the newly fixed laws were too numerous, the old laws were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the tenth winter month, because the newly fixed laws were too numerous, the old laws were restored.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以遼興軍節度使何葛為乙室大王。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Hege was made Yishi great king.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Liaoxing Army military commissioner Hege was made Yishi great king.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁卯朔，燕國王延禧生子，大赦，妃之族屬進爵有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingmao new moon, Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son; general amnesty; the consort's kin advanced in rank by degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao new moon of the eleventh month Prince of Yan Yanxi had a son; a general amnesty was proclaimed; the consort's kin advanced in rank by degree.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月，如混同江。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, went to the Huntong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the first spring month the court went to the Huntong River.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，駐蹕雙山。

translations.literal: Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai memorialized victory over Daridi.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai memorialized victory over Daridi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅朔，惕德萌得斯、老古得等各率所部來附，詔復舊地。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on renyin new moon, Tide Mengdesi, Laogude, and others each led their tribes to submit; edict restored their former lands.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon of the fourth summer month Tide Mengdesi, Laogude, and others each led their tribes to submit; an edict restored their former lands.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，駐蹕春州北平澱。

translations.literal: On jiachen day halted at Chun Prefecture North Ping Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the court halted at Chun Prefecture North Ping Marsh.

sentences.zh: 丙午，烏古部節度使耶律陳家奴奏討茶紥剌捷。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu memorialized victory over Chazhala.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Wugu tribal military commissioner Yelü Chenjianu memorialized victory over Chazhala.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以知北院樞密使事耶律斡特剌為都統，夷離畢耶律禿朵為副統，龍虎衛上將軍耶律胡呂都監，討磨古斯，遣積慶宮使蕭虬裏監戰。

translations.literal: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yelü Wotela, who administered Northern Court privy affairs, was made supreme commander; yilibi Yelü Tuduo deputy commander; Dragon-Tiger Guard upper general Yelü Hulu army supervisor to attack Mogusi; Jiqing Palace commissioner Xiao Qiuli supervised the campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，朽哥奏頗裏八部來侵。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Xiuge memorialized that the Poli Eight Tribes came to invade.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Xiuge memorialized that the Poli Eight Tribes came to invade.

sentences.zh: 擊破之。

translations.literal: They were defeated and broken.
translations.idiomatic: They were defeated and broken.

sentences.zh: 己巳，除玉田、密雲流民租賦一年。

translations.literal: On jisi day rent and tax for refugees in Yutian and Miyun were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day rent and tax for refugees in Yutian and Miyun were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚子，賜西北路貧民錢。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on gengzi day money was bestowed on poor people in the Northwest Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengzi day, money was bestowed on poor people in the Northwest Route.

sentences.zh: 達裏底、拔思母二部來降。

translations.literal: Daridi and Basimu two tribes came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Daridi and Basimu two tribes came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，駐蹕赤勒嶺。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen day, halted at Chile Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the fifth month the court halted at Chile Ridge.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，括馬。

translations.literal: On jiayin day horses were registered.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day horses were registered.

sentences.zh: 戊午，西北路招討司奏敵烈等部來侵，統軍司出兵與戰，不利，招討司以兵擊破之，敦睦宮太師耶律愛奴及其子死之。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Northwest Route pacification office memorialized that Dilie and other tribes came to invade; the supreme commander's office sent troops to fight with unfavorable result; the pacification office broke them with troops; Dunmu Palace grand preceptor Yelü Ainu and his son died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Northwest Route pacification office memorialized that Dilie and other tribes came to invade; the supreme commander's office sent troops to fight with unfavorable result; the pacification office broke them with troops; Dunmu Palace grand preceptor Yelü Ainu and his son died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以知國舅詳穩事蕭阿烈同領西北路行軍事。

translations.literal: On xinyou day imperial maternal uncle detail-stable administrator Xiao Alie jointly led Northwest Route campaign affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day imperial maternal uncle detail-stable administrator Xiao Alie jointly led Northwest Route campaign affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，宋遣使來謝吊祭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day Song dispatched envoys to thank for the condolence mission.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day of the sixth month Song sent envoys to thank for the condolence mission.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，烏古敵烈統軍使朽哥有罪，除名。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Xiuge, for an offense, was struck from the register.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Wugu Dilie supreme commander Xiuge, for an offense, was struck from the register.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，和烈葛等部來聘。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Heliege and other tribes came with a friendly mission.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Heliege and other tribes came with a friendly mission.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，惕德來貢。

translations.literal: On guisi day Tide came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Tide came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，禁邊民與蕃部為婚。

translations.literal: On jihai day forbidden border people to marry tribal peoples.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day border people were forbidden to marry tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 是夏，高麗國王運薨，子昱遣使來告，即遣使賻贈。

translations.literal: That summer Goryeo king Yun died; his son Yu dispatched envoys to announce it; envoys were immediately dispatched with funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Goryeo king Yun died; his son Yu sent envoys to announce it; envoys were immediately dispatched with funeral gifts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子朔，獵赤山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on gengzi new moon, hunted at Red Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon of the seventh autumn month the court hunted at Red Mountain.

sentences.zh: 是月，阻卜等寇倒塌嶺，盡掠西路群牧馬去，東北路統軍使耶律石柳以兵追及，盡獲所掠而還。

translations.literal: That month Zubu and others raided Daotaoling, carrying off all Western Route herd horses; Northeast Route supreme commander Yelü Shiliu pursued with troops, recovered all that was plundered, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zubu and others raided Daotaoling, carrying off all Western Route herd horses; Northeast Route supreme commander Yelü Shiliu pursued with troops, recovered all that was plundered, and returned.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以南院大王特末為南院樞密使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on jiwei day Southern Court great king Temo was made Southern Court privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the ninth month Southern Court great king Temo was made Southern Court privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敵烈諸酋來降，釋其罪。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Dilie tribal chiefs came to surrender; their crimes were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Dilie tribal chiefs came to surrender; their crimes were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 是月，斡特剌破磨古斯。

translations.literal: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wotela defeated Mogusi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙子，駐蹕藕絲澱。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingzi day, halted at Ousi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day of the tenth winter month the court halted at Ousi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 壬午，山北路副部署蕭阿魯帶以討達裏底功，加左金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On renwu day Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai, for merit against Daridi, was promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Northern Mountain Route deputy deployment Xiao Arudai, for merit against Daridi, was promoted Left Defender of the Golden Crow Commandant grand general.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，西北路統軍司獲阻卜長拍撒葛、蒲魯等來獻。

translations.literal: On guisi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office captured Zubu chiefs Paisage, Pulu, and others who came to present captives.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office captured Zubu chiefs Paisage, Pulu, and others who came to present captives.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，惕德銅刮、阻卜的烈等來降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yisi day Tide Tonggua, Zubu Dilie, and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day of the eleventh month Tide Tonggua, Zubu Dilie, and others came to surrender.

sentences.zh: 達裏底及拔思母等復來侵，山北副部署阿魯帶擊敗之。

translations.literal: Daridi and Basimu again came to invade; Northern Mountain deputy deployment Arudai defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Daridi and Basimu again came to invade; Northern Mountain deputy deployment Arudai defeated them.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，三河縣民孫賓及其妻皆百歲，復其家。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on guiyou day Sanhe County commoner Sun Bin and his wife were both one hundred years old; their household was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the twelfth month Sanhe County commoner Sun Bin and his wife were both one hundred years old; their household was remitted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以參知政事趙廷睦兼同知樞密院事，樞密副使王師儒參知政事兼同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Tingmu also associate administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Tingmu was also made associate administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate privy commissioner Wang Shiru Associate Administrator of Affairs and associate administrator of Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔錄西北路有功將士及戰歿者，贈官。

translations.literal: On jimao day, edict ordered recording meritorious officers and those killed in battle in the Northwest Route and posthumously granting office.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict ordered recording meritorious officers and those killed in battle in the Northwest Route and posthumously granting office.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔改明年元，減雜犯死罪以下，仍除貧民租賦。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, edict changed the coming year's era name, reduced mixed offenses from capital crime downward, and still remitted rent and tax for poor people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day an edict changed the coming year's era name, reduced mixed offenses from capital crime downward, and still remitted rent and tax for poor people.

sentences.zh: 戊子，西北路統軍司奏討磨古斯捷。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Northwest Route supreme commander's office memorialized victory over Mogusi.
